mapper.select: SELECT id, name, `key`, category, display_order, create_time, update_time FROM questionnaire_item ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, `key`, category, display_order, create_time, update_time FROM questionnaire_item WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questionnaire_item (name, `key`, category, display_order, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{key}, #{category}, #{displayOrder}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
